objects.name: receipt-roll
objects.rejected: Pale lavender-white paper on a white ground: its edge contrast on #F4F4F1 is about 1.1:1, below the 3:1 floor for a graphic object, so it vanishes on paper (the failure D29 names). It is also the one object on the sheet that is not royal blue.

objects.name: bank-card
objects.rejected: Carries two overlapping orange and blue discs bottom right, which is a card-network mark in everything but name. D13 forbids a card artefact that looks like a debit or credit card or implies a card product, and Vallo issues none.

objects.name: hotel-canopy
objects.rejected: The word HOTEL is baked into the sign board. D29: no text in any asset, and Vallo ships in four languages.
